sentences.text:
On The 8 th Of March, 2025
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 29365 of 2023
 Mukesh Jatav
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh And Others
 Appearance:
 Shri Alok Kumar Sharma - Advocate for the petitioner.
 Shri A.K.Nirankari - Public Prosecutor for the respondent
 Order

This petition under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. has been filed by the petitioner seeking quashment of FIR registered against him at Crime No.378/2020 at Police Station Thatipur, District Gwalior for the offences under punishable under Section 376(2)(N), 323, 506 of IPC and Section 3/ 4 of POCSO Act as well as all consequential proceedings.
2. As per the status report, vide order dated 30.09.2023, impugned proceedings have been concluded by the trial Court.
Hence, the purpose of filing the instant petition is over and the petition has rendered infructuous.
3. In view of the aforesaid, nothing survives in this petition to address upon and the same is hereby dismissed having been rendered infructuous.

(ANAND PATHAK)
